exact_prompt: Generate a transparent 4-column x 1-row atlas of the SAME upright wooden training dummy, repairing ONLY the base shape in its four vertical elevations. Columns left-to-right: FRONT, RIGHT SIDE, LEFT SIDE, REAR. Preserve the exact source identity, centered upright post, head, crossbar pose, materials, proportions, pixel-art style, and keep the camera orthographic. The current source and accepted TOP/BOTTOM views show the support is a square wooden plank platform. In ALL FOUR views show this same low square wooden platform edge/support under the dummy: FRONT and REAR have the long platform edge, RIGHT and LEFT have the shorter end edge, with square corners and plank seams. Do NOT use a circular black-rimmed target base. Do not alter the body pose, limb positions, hand orientation or scale; only replace the round base with the square wood platform. One complete centered silhouette per equal-width cell, transparent background, no labels, no floor, no shadows.
